_authority: AR-1265 §4/§5/§9 (live registration + hash-pinned dirty exception) on top of AR-1254 §10 + AR-1236 §11 (activate the existing toolbox, do not rebuild it)
_what_this_is: The manifest the pinned toolbox's claude-hook-runner.mjs requires. It does NOT restate the lane rules — those live in lane-boundary-guard.mjs::classifyPath inside the pinned toolbox, and a second copy of a boundary rule is a rule that drifts and stops biting while still reporting PASS. edit_scope NARROWS this packet on top of that.
_toolbox_pin_history: dd1bc230 (AR-1254) -> 6a06ffae (AR-1266 §E). The new pin is a DESCENDANT of the old one and carries AR-1264 A+C and AR-1266 A-C, all reviewed by AR-1265. bundle_sha256 is COMPUTED by scripts/claude_toolbox.mjs materialize over 40 files, never hand-copied.

session_anchor._expected_head_is_a_ref_on_purpose: resume-anchor-guard resolves expected_head with `rev-parse <x>^{commit}`, so a REF NAME works and a pinned SHA would go stale on the next commit — a guard that is stale by design gets disabled by whoever it annoys. Anchoring to the branch still catches a detached HEAD, the wrong branch, and a checkout that is not at the branch tip.
session_anchor._dirty_disposition: AR-1265 §4 REPLACES the standing block. The desk refused BOTH remedies the worker could have taken alone: do NOT commit the timestamp-only docs/wave25-exit-engine-ab-report.md merely to make the guard green, and do NOT set require_clean:false. Instead this exception pins the exact path AND the sha256 of the exact `git diff HEAD --binary -- <path>` bytes. Any future edit to that file changes the diff and blocks SessionStart, so the historical finding is preserved without letting anything else hide behind the same filename. diff_sha256 was COMPUTED and cross-checked by two instruments (the guard's own dirtyDiffSha256 and `git diff | sha256sum`), never hand-copied.
session_anchor._still_forbidden: A blanket allow-dirty, a glob, a directory, an entry with no diff hash, an entry with no authority, and allowed_dirty combined with require_clean:false are all refused by resume-anchor-guard by construction, not by convention. Untracked files remain blocking and cannot be laundered by listing them.

edit_scope._not_listed_is_not_allowed: Runtime, PAPER, broker/Topstep, compiler execution semantics and the backtester are absent deliberately. AR-1249 §12 and AR-1254 §12 keep them LOCKED, and Worker-2 production authority is not unlocked here.
edit_scope._claude_prefix_is_not_authority_over_the: `.claude/` appears above, but AR-1263 §7A self-protection is evaluated FIRST and is never scope-overridable — this manifest, .claude/settings*.json, .claude/hooks/ and the pinned toolbox all DENY regardless of what this list says. That is deliberate: a worker must never gain permission to edit the file that declares its own permissions merely because a broad prefix covers it.

g2_precall._why_enabled_now: AR-1265 §5.4. With PreToolUse now registering Agent/Task, a G2-shaped subagent dispatch without a valid durable pre-call permit is refused BEFORE the model call. Post-call refusal cannot un-spend a one-shot attempt.
g2_precall._why_strict_session_is_false_here: AR-1265 §3.2 arms strict mode for the DEDICATED eight-call execution session only, where every Agent/Task dispatch requires a permit and ordinary helper work is simply not allowed. This packet is not that session, and the non-G2 calibration must run BEFORE strict mode is armed rather than as an exemption carved inside it. Flipping this to true is a deliberate act for the execution session, not a default.

finish._why_disabled: claude-finish-check needs a committed receipt file describing a finished packet. G2-D has not run, so there is no finished packet to check and enabling it would make TaskCompleted assert against a receipt that does not exist. It is switched on when a real finish receipt exists — an enabled check with nothing to check is the false-green shape this desk keeps convicting. AR-1265 §5.7 also holds full `P1 NATIVE ACTIVE` back until TaskCompleted finish enforcement is proven, and AR-1264 §7 reported that claude-finish-check still carries the old structural REVIEW_REQUIRED problem — it will bite the moment finish is armed.
